subject.title: fix(android): default manual TLS port to 18789 except Tailscale hosts

question: Should Android intentionally change blank manual gateway ports to match the iOS contract: non-tailnet TLS and cleartext default to 18789, while `.ts.net` TLS defaults to 443?
rationale: The patch is focused and tested, but it changes an existing Android upgrade default that some public HTTPS users may have relied on.

options.title: Accept iOS parity defaults
options.body: Merge the resolver behavior and expect users needing non-tailnet HTTPS port 443 to enter 443 explicitly.

options.title: Preserve broader 443 compatibility
options.body: Keep blank TLS on 443 for more Android hostnames or add a compatibility affordance before changing existing behavior.

options.title: Narrow this PR to TLS parity only
options.body: Remove the blank-cleartext default change if maintainers do not want that behavior bundled into this fix.

recommendation.title: Accept iOS parity defaults
recommendation.body: Merge the resolver behavior and expect users needing non-tailnet HTTPS port 443 to enter 443 explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and authored the latest commits shaping the default behavior.
